total_supply.meaning: totalSupply value of the vault, set to 1,000,000 shares by the constructor

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] over all accounts

ghost_shares_unminted.meaning: the 1,000,000 constructor shares are never minted to any account, so they have zero corresponding balances

deposit_over_mint_occurs.meaning: a deposit mints more shares to the new entrant than their fair pro-rata allocation, diluting incumbents

assumptions: The ERC-20 invariant totalSupply == sum(balanceOf[]) is required to hold unconditionally, not only at construction.
The constructor's totalSupply assignment is treated as the reported erroneous value rather than a deliberate allocation.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of the fair pro-rata allocation or the over-minted share amount, so the magnitude of deposits_over_mint cannot be encoded; only the qualitative over-mint occurrence is bound.

limitations: The impact magnitude (excess shares minted) is not quantified in the report; the relation captures the invariant violation rather than a numeric over-mint amount.
No attacker transaction is described; the ghost shares originate in the constructor, so no action step is modeled.
